nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Nasaq posts here. Raw Body is ON because the signature covers the exact bytes.

nodes.name: Evolution — sendText
nodes.notes: Same shape as the workflow already sending on this server: flat number/text, apikey header, Evolution API v2. The key stays in $env so it is never committed. Do not switch on 'Continue on Fail' — it would answer 200 on a failed send and Nasaq would record a message as delivered that never arrived.

nodes.name: 401 Bad signature
nodes.notes: Nasaq treats this as a failure and retries — which is right, because a wrong secret is a configuration error somebody must fix, not a message to drop.
